title: cryptocarya ferrea var. oblongifolia
intro: Cryptocarya ferrea var. oblongifolia, commonly known as the "Brazilian rosewood", is a plant species in the family Lauraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Cryptocarya ferrea var. oblongifolia include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
